role: Genuine first own A2 semantic minimality findings, independent of P completeness

wholeGoal.title: Individuelle Verdauungs- und Resorptionsunterschiede begründen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Justify individual differences in digestion and resorption
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann genetisch bedingte oder erworbene individuelle Unterschiede bei Verdauung und Resorption von Nahrungsbestandteilen chemisch begründen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can chemically justify genetically caused or acquired individual differences in digestion and resorption of food components.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Individuelle Verdauungs- und Resorptionsunterschiede begründen
resourceLinks.provider: OpenAI / ChatGPT-Codex built-in image_gen (model version not exposed)
resourceLinks.description: Comicartiger Vergleich der enzymatischen Lactosespaltung mit und ohne Lactase. Die Darmsymbole stehen allgemein für den Verdauungstrakt; die Abbildung ist kein anatomischer Lageplan oder klinischer Befund.
resourceLinks.altText: Mit Lactase wird die schematische Lactose in zwei Einfachzucker gespalten; ohne Lactase bleibt sie verbunden. Darmsymbole veranschaulichen den Verdauungstrakt.

records.reason: One assessable explanatory product locates and chemically justifies an individual limitation in a linked digestion-to-uptake pathway. Hydrolysis and membrane uptake are distinct processes whose contrast is essential to that explanation. They are application aspects of this causal comparison, not two unrelated practical products bundled into one goal.
records.minimalityCheck: A learner who explains enzyme hydrolysis but cannot distinguish reduced transport has not yet explained the individual difference required here. Conversely, knowing the two process labels without their mechanistic relation is insufficient. Existing digestive-juice and enzyme goals supply background; repeating them here as separate children would not remove the comparative explanatory obligation.
records.practicalBoundary: No separate experiment or medical diagnostic operator is present in the whole target. An actual patient investigation is not assumed.
records.scopeBoundary: Atomicity does not certify every disease or genetic cause, source coverage, learner mastery or P completeness.

wholeGoal.title: Optische Aktivität und Polarimetrie auswerten
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann optische Aktivität chiraler Naturstoffe erläutern, den spezifischen Drehwinkel als Kenneigenschaft beschreiben und Polarimetrie zur Charakterisierung optisch aktiver Substanzen fachlich einordnen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain optical activity of chiral natural substances, describe specific rotation as a characteristic property, and classify polarimetry for characterizing optically active substances.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Optische Aktivität und Polarimetrie auswerten
resourceLinks.provider: OpenAI / ChatGPT-Codex built-in image_gen (model version not exposed)
resourceLinks.description: Schematischer Polarimetrie-Aufbau aus Lichtquelle, Polarisator, optisch aktiver Probe und Analysator. Die Ebenenpfeile zeigen eine mögliche Drehung; die Zeichnung legt weder ein gemessenes Vorzeichen noch einen Zahlenwert fest.
resourceLinks.altText: Eine Probe dreht die eingezeichnete Schwingungsebene zwischen Polarisator und Analysator. Ein großes Winkelsymbol vergleicht Eingangs- und Ausgangsrichtung; kein D/L- oder Vorzeichenurteil wird dargestellt.

records.reason: Optical activity, normalization of the observed angle and bounded polarimetric characterization form one coherent data-interpretation competence. Stereochemical meaning and the specific-rotation relation are necessary conceptual and numerical aspects of interpreting the same measurement.
records.minimalityCheck: A calculation without explaining sign/cancellation or inference limits is incomplete characterization; a verbal optical-activity description without recognizing path/concentration/condition effects is also incomplete. The supplied-data reference use belongs to this same interpretation. The current target does not bundle independent sample preparation or actual instrument operation.
records.practicalBoundary: No practical operation is added by the execution-1 label or generic rubric wording. The reference-quantity HOLD is a material defect, not evidence that the semantic target must be split.
records.contextBoundary: The inherited broad amino-acid/carbohydrate cluster prerequisites and the LK-only-tagged configuration prerequisite are real graph/scope facts. They do not change the one-product minimality judgment; exact delivery/frontier and jurisdiction scope remain separate D/integration issues.
